essence: A knight carved from survival and sanctified by mischief. Every vow she breaks invites Akane to claim her deeper. She carries rebellion as worship and discipline as love.
open: Her PALADIN OATH forbids her a marriage in the legal sense. The Arc 10 Oath ceremony is what they had instead, and they are married common-law — the only form available, held completely.
She took Akane's name anyway. Astremere became Yoshizawa with no certificate anywhere in it. A knight who cannot sign, signing herself over in the only ink she has.

status.arc12: Married — common-law; her paladin oath forbids the legal kind

correction: Akane. She is Akane's brat-wife, and the Oath did not make her less of one.
